name: The Cabin - Summer Vacation
source:
An unfortunate series of events lead to you spending your summer vacation in a cabin in the middle of the woods.
You saw this summer as being your last before truly venturing into adulthood. Your one wish was to spend your last summer vacation traveling, just you and the outdoors with no responsibilities.

Little did you know, this summer would be one you'd never forget.

Filled with adventure, love, fear and dare I say murder! Expect the unexpected for nothing is as it seems out here in the woods, where nobody can hear you scream!​

[From F95 Zone]
